notes: v320 keeps custom simulation rows, angles, actions, profile name, and description as a durable local draft when the user leaves and returns to Servo Simulation. RPC save, load, delete, selection, persistence, and Community upload handoff now share the authoritative simulation editor instead of competing listeners. The existing printer action follows the active Servo Program or Servo Simulation tab and prints either the unchanged generated build sheet or a clearly labeled custom RPC simulation profile. v319 Community RPC packages remain supported.
